properties.displayName: UAV Campaign C7 - Container Kill → Detection Blind Spot → GCS Breach
properties.description: telemetry-tap 강제 중단(S23, ActorId 컬럼) → 20분 내 GCS 비인가 로그인(S6, Operator 컬럼). 시간 인접성 체인. 실제 컬럼: ActorId(Operator 아님), Operator(OperatorId 아님). MITRE: T1489, T1078
properties.query:
let windowSize = 30m;
let ApprovedOps = _GetWatchlist('Approved_Arm_Operator_List') | project OperatorId;
// S23: telemetry-tap 강제 중단 시각 (전역 스칼라)
let S23_Time = toscalar(
    UAVServiceAudit_CL
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(windowSize)
    | where ContainerName == 'telemetry-tap'
    | where Action in ('stop', 'kill')
    | summarize min(TimeGenerated));
// S6: 탐지 맹점 구간 내 GCS 비인가 로그인
UAVOpAudit_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(windowSize)
| where EventType == 'login_success'
| where Operator !in (ApprovedOps)
| where isnotnull(S23_Time) and TimeGenerated >= S23_Time and TimeGenerated <= S23_Time + 20m
| extend T1 = S23_Time, T2 = TimeGenerated
| extend BlindWindowMin = datetime_diff('minute', T2, T1)
| extend CampaignType = "C7_서비스중단_탐지맹점_GCS침해"
| extend StepSummary = strcat("S23@", tostring(T1), "(telemetry-tap종료)→S6@", tostring(T2), "(맹점", tostring(BlindWindowMin), "분후)")
| extend Severity = "High"
| project T1, T2, Operator, ClientIp, BlindWindowMin, CampaignType, StepSummary, Severity

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: [CAMPAIGN] UAV Campaign C7 - Container Kill → Detection Blind Spot → GCS Breach - {{Operator}}
